description: The student's own EduAvenues writing feedback (SPS/PSE), released by their coach. With no submissionId, lists recent submissions per child with status and released scores. With a submissionId, returns the full released report: the prompt, the student's response, scores, rubric rows, the coach's inline comments, strengths and priorities, plus the matching TJ Prep rubric lessons. Only released feedback is ever returned.
